lines.text: Beats random entries (return per capital-day +0.2882% against a random median of +0.0104%, p = 0.0065 (Holm over 4, B = 10,000), 135 trades). Development only: not evidence for enabling anything.

lines.model: The strategy against random entries with its own exits
lines.text: Too few trades to tell: this test could only see an edge above +0.2087% a capital-day (return per capital-day +0.1683% against a random median of +0.1094%, p = 0.1836 (Holm over 4, B = 10,000), 151 trades). Development only: not evidence for enabling anything.

Not shown to be profitable after fees: a profit in each half (net $+1,692.94 on £10,000, return per capital-day +0.2882%, 135 trades, maximum drawdown 7.32%, p = 0.0086 (Holm over 4), smallest detectable return per capital-day +0.5595%). Development only: not evidence for enabling anything.

Not shown to be profitable after fees: a drawdown below the halt level (net $+1,528.33 on £10,000, return per capital-day +0.1683%, 151 trades, maximum drawdown 10.14%, p = 0.0001 (Holm over 4), smallest detectable return per capital-day +0.2586%). Development only: not evidence for enabling anything.
